GCP Data Engineer

Location: Nashville, TN
Employment type: Contract

Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and processing solutions on Google Cloud Platform. Build data workflows with Dataflow and BigQuery, and implement ingestion patterns for both large-scale processing and streaming use cases. Work across the data lifecycle to improve reliability, performance, and data quality. Collaborate with technical partners to deliver maintainable cloud data solutions that support downstream analytics and business needs.

Core skills
Google Cloud Platform

ETL/ELT
Data pipelines
Streaming
Required qualifications
Experience designing and maintaining data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform.
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Dataflow.
Experience building and optimizing solutions with BigQuery.
Experience implementing data ingestion with Pub/Sub.
Knowledge of ETL/ELT workflows for large-scale data processing.
Ability to build reliable batch or streaming data solutions.
Experience monitoring data quality and pipeline performance.
Preferred qualifications
Experience designing high-performance data architectures or Spark-based workloads on GCP.
